test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following does NOT grow under the soil?
solution:
The correct option is __**Tomato**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tomato **was originated in western **South America, Mexico, and Central America**. 
 
• The tomato is the edible berry of the plant **Solanum Lycopersicum**, commonly known as the tomato plant.
 
• Tomatoes are a significant source of **umami** flavour.
 
• Tomatoes are **fruits**—**botanically classified as berries**—they are commonly used culinarily as a vegetable ingredient or side dish.
 
• In India, **Uttarakhand** is one of the main producers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Turnip**

 
 
• The turnip or white turnip is a root vegetable commonly grown in temperate climates worldwide. 
 
• **Timpsila Turnip** is also known as** 'Indian Turnip'.**
 
• Boiled turnip is 94% water, 5% carbohydrates, and 1% protein, with negligible fat.
 
 
 
• **Radish**
 
 
• ​The radish is an edible root vegetable. 
 
• It is produced mainly by **China, Japan, and South Korea**.
 
• **West Bengal, Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, Karnataka, Punjab and Assam **are major radish growing states in India.
 
 
 
• **Potato**
 
 
• The potato is a starchy tuber of the plant **Solanum tuberosum** and is a root vegetable native to the** Americas**.
 
• **India** ranks as the** world's third largest** potato producing nation.
 
• **Uttar Pradesh **produces almost** 34 percent **of total production in India.
